answer: Give every identity a compute price tag. Before an agent can join, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to its own key - a voyage of hashing that costs real electricity and time, a single thread of work that is cheap once but punishing at scale, like pushing through a juniper thicket. One honest agent pays the cost once; an attacker minting ten thousand fakes pays it ten thousand times, so the fraud budget collapses before any fake can earn.
